newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Lower Chicago keeps European feeds subdued.
newsitem.headline: Lower Chicago keeps European feeds subdued.

text.p: A weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening kept a firm lid on trade on the European meals and feeds market this afternoon, market sources said.

"After Friday's lower Chicago soymeal futures close and a weaker Project A night trade this morning kept buyers sidelined in anticipation Chicago futures would drop further this afternoon," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $139.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam and afloat cornglutenfeed pellets traded at $154 a tonne fob Amsterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
